$schema_note: Operator reference for Microsoft Intune Win32 app fields. Not consumed by IntuneWinAppUtil; copy values into the portal or Graph API payload.
description: Endpoint collector for AI coding-tool telemetry (Claude Code). Installs payload under Program Files, machine config under ProgramData (ACL SYSTEM+Admins), and a SYSTEM scheduled task every 5 minutes for scan/flush/heartbeat.

ring0.notes: Security team pilot devices only. Rotate install-command secrets after pilot.

secrets.preferredDelivery: Intune remediation script fetches ring token from secrets broker into %ProgramData%\AI-Monitoring\collector\ before install/detection
secrets.pilotStopgap: Per-ring install command with -Token / -EnrollToken (visible to Intune admins; rotate after pilot)

optionalRemediation.name: AIM Collector WSL bridge
optionalRemediation.notes: Enrolls each WSL distro with the Linux collector path using the same ring secrets already on the Windows host.
